purpose: A timer whose start time is computed during the solve exists only in the instance's live schedule (pendingBreakpoint); the transient must land on every re-armed fire.

oracle.derivation: VAMS-2023 5.10.3.3 and 4.5.8: tnext starts at per = 1 us and each fire toggles lvl and re-arms tnext += per, so lvl flips at 1, 2, 3 and 4 us, and transition(lvl, 0, 100 ns) slews V(out) linearly over the 100 ns after each fire. A fire landed late shifts the whole ramp: without the per-instance breakpoints the first fire lands at the step after 1 us (1.028 us) and V(out) at 1.05 us reads 0.22.
